name: list-api-keys
description: List all API keys from Resend. Returns API key names, IDs, and creation dates. Don't bother telling the user the IDs or creation dates unless they ask for them.

limit.description: Number of API keys to retrieve. Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: API key ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: API key ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
